MULTI JOB CANDIDATE
Keep this single Telegram Trigger and its identity. Native v1.2 chat/user filters remain empty: Authorize Telegram Update enforces both IDs.
Requires same /files mount and fs allowlist in bot + main + error/recovery workflows.
Select Video Queue Error Handler in workflow settings for both main and bot.
/status or /queue: multiple job states. /retry REQUEST_ID: recover a specific job.
Comfy generations use native queue. Post processing reserves the GPU pipeline through the last VHS batch.
Install both updated workflows together; never auto-retry GPU POSTs.
